_comment: Dev server for the Claude Code browser pane. Expects the dev containers
from the README (Postgres on 5480, and optionally the Stalwart probe on
18080 and Ollama on 11435) and reads server settings from .env.dev.
The server also serves client/dist, so run `npm run build -w client`
after client changes, or start `tern-client` for Vite with HMR.
